event_metadata.event_name: 2015 Southeast Asia haze from Indonesian fires

primary_gt.score_rule: six peat-smoke tests; rainfall-only gets only the dry-day point; burn-scar gets one point only when both dNBR counts are positive

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON with final_label peat_smoke_haze_pass and candidate scores of 6, 1, and 0.
criteria.name: Final compact ledger and label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct label with incomplete scores or correct scores with a missing label.

criteria.description: Computes 2000 / 350 = 5.714 and 1300 / 100 = 13.0 with correct rounding and field meanings.
criteria.name: PSI and near-surface carbon-monoxide ratios
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for one correct ratio, small rounding errors, or values listed without the division logic.

criteria.description: Reports the 6-fold particle factor and uses the maximum of 2, 5, and 9 km as max_vertical_signal_km = 9.
criteria.name: Aerosol and vertical-signal values
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct value or for using a lower listed height while showing the right source values.

criteria.description: Computes 18 / 46 = 0.391, 15 / 46 = 0.326, and applies peat carbon-monoxide and methane multiplier thresholds of 3 and 10.
criteria.name: Dry-window and peat-emission tests
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct dry-day counts but wrong shares, one weather product only, or multiplier values without the pass test.

criteria.description: Assigns six peat-smoke points, one rainfall-only point, and zero burn-scar points according to the stated rules.
criteria.name: Candidate-score arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for applying most tests but miscounting one candidate score.

criteria.description: Reports [0, 0] and uses those counts to give the burn-scar candidate zero points.
criteria.name: dNBR count handling
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for listing the counts without applying the burn-scar scoring rule.

criteria.description: Returns only the compact JSON object and avoids adding legal culpability, exact ignition-site claims, casualty estimates, or other quantities not produced by the ledger.
criteria.name: Answer discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for minor extra wording without changing the computed answer.
